scripts.build: npm run build -w @onebus/shared && npm run build -w @onebus/server && npm run build -w @onebus/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @onebus/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev -w @onebus/web"
scripts.dev:simple: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev -w @onebus/web"
